name: Team Bulbasaur: Sevii Expeditionary Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago traversal — Sleep status control, Ice/Water artillery, Fighting physical breaking, Intimidate pivoting, and Levitate Ground immunity.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle in Chapter 18. All six party members train and travel together in full 6-member route configuration, exploring Knot Island, Treasure Beach, Kindle Road, and Mt. Ember under the Level 72 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 72. Sleep Powder shuts down wild threats instantly. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Mt. Ember's Bug and Grass types, while Petal Dance melts Kindle Road's Water spawns.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Ice Beam and Hydro Pump crush Mt. Ember's Graveler and Fire types. Water Absorb provides passive healing across ocean surfing routes.
500 BST physical wallbreaker. Crabhammer obliterates Rock and Ground spawns on Mt. Ember, while Close Combat breaks Kindle Road martial artists.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Lowers enemy physical Attack on entry to defang Mt. Ember's Machoke and Graveler. Glare provides 100% paralysis control.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake and Magnitude via Levitate — completely shuts down Mt. Ember's Ground encounters while Psychic melts Fighting types.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks on Mt. Ember. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain across long island route traversal.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder for securing wild Sevii catches and shutting down dangerous trainers.
High-speed Discharge and Light Screen against ocean water routes and aerial Fearow.
High Jump Kick physical breaker for Rock and Normal type encounters.
